rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose description of someone who does not openly show their feelings.

example.english: They are very undemonstrative; even when they win an award, they only smile.

rows.jyutping: m4 hai6 hou2 biu2 daat6 gam2 cing4
rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean that the person does not express emotions openly.

example.english: My dad is undemonstrative and quietly looks after me.
example.jyutping: m4 hai6 hou2 biu2 daat6 gam2 cing4

rows.note: Use this when the reservedness comes across as distant or lacking warmth, rather than merely quiet.

example.english: They are so undemonstrative toward us that I thought we had offended them.
